_comment: Old installers the upgrade matrix (packaging/upgrade_matrix.ps1, CI job 'installer') upgrades FROM. Each entry is a released JARVES-Setup-<v>.exe, pinned by SHA256 (download it from the release assets, record the hash once). Series: 0.1.0.x (old run-number series), 3.0.0.x, later 4.0.0.x. Empty until the owner / first release pins them; the CI step then says so and does not pretend the matrix ran.
